nameOrigin: sound a cat makes when content

pokedexEntries.di: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.

pokedexEntries.prl: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

pokedexEntries.pt: It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.
